question: Do the original ten acute-LMNA relative-gain candidates show a decrease exceeding0.5 in mean log2(FPKM+0.5) in R225X cardiomyocytes against each of two corrected isogenic clones?
units: Three independently differentiated cultures per line per GEO. No invented pairing; same mutant samples used in each separate corrected-clone comparison.

analysis.test: one-sided Welch threshold t-test; union maximum over two corrected-clone comparisons; Holm10
analysis.promotion: both primary delta<=-0.5, Holm<=0.05, all leave-one-culture-out contrasts<0, both sensitivities<=-0.5

eligibility: FPKM>=1 in at least2/3 cultures and meanFPKM>=1 in EACH corrected clone; every group must have nonzero logFPKM variance. Unmapped, ambiguous or missing genes remain p=1.
mapping: Exact pre-outcome Ensembl ID from deposited Cuffdiff identifier columns; ZFTA prior symbol C11orf95 is admitted from HGNC before outcomes. No post-outcome mapping repairs.
access_disclosure: No GSE126458 numerical FPKM or differential outcomes opened by investigator/design/data-audit workers before freeze.
Header and identifier columns inspected only. Primary article and GEO metadata read.
All GSE300197/GSE304575 outcomes were already exposed; H222P failures retained and never renamed as independent holdout.
Within-session freeze has no independent timestamp authority; public-data/model-training exposure cannot be ruled out.
claim_ceiling: Model-dependent cultured-line expression association or failed large-effect prediction. No universal LMNA signature, absolute abundance change, newly discovered lamin target, causal mechanism or biological validation.
limitations: Welch t is approximate; n=3 per line prevents credible normality diagnostics.
FPKM is processed relative abundance, not raw counts; threshold refers to transformed abundance rather than exact raw-FPKM percentage.
One patient-derived mutant clone and two corrected clones: genotype/clone effects remain inseparable.
Independent differentiations are distinct culture units, not independent donors; no population-level precision.
R225X mutation and day14 differentiation differ from acute day35 LMNA depletion and H222P.
No candidate selection or backfill after this outcome; significance is not novelty.
failure_policy: Retire the specific cross-context large-repression claim for any failing gene; keep context-specific original observations. All outcomes retained, no retries with looser thresholds.
other_datasets: GSE136252 is excluded from this formal test due raw-versus-normalized sample discrepancies and missing clone/differentiation map. Any later descriptive use gets a separate predeclared analysis; no confirmatory significance.
